# InNetworkNeuromorphic

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The integration of neuromorphic computing principles directly into network infrastructure, enabling distributed, low-latency signal processing at the edge. This aligns with iNEST's goal of embedding intelligence in the network, potentially enabling real-time quantum gate synthesis and error correction within the communication fabric.
